name: Numeric predicate
description: Evaluates a numeric input against a configured comparison operator and reference value(s), outputting a boolean result.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The numeric input value to be evaluated against the configured operator and reference value(s).

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: A boolean output that is true when the input value satisfies the configured comparison, and false otherwise.

config.name: Operator
config.description: The comparison operator used to evaluate the input value against the configured reference value(s).

config.name: Operand
config.description: The reference value used for comparison with the input. For the 'Between' operator, this serves as the lower bound of the range.

config.name: Operand 2
config.description: The upper bound of the range for the 'Between' operator. The comparison is inclusive: output is true when the input value is greater than or equal to operand AND less than or equal to operand_2.
